$about: Canonical customer-facing commerce copy manifest (translation source freeze). English is the SOURCE of meaning; final translations for all 13 locales are produced by a human language reviewer from this file — never machine-translated, never English-copied. Storefront keys live in src/i18n/messages/<locale>.json; email.* keys live in the maky-apps SMTP repo (apps/smtp/src/modules/smtp/i18n/catalogs/<locale>.json, branch maky-i18n-order-email on the makysto remote). Per key: runtimeStatus production|staging-only|dormant (translate production + staging-only; dormant keys are kept for documented reasons), callSites/usageCount (storefront keys; verified by scripts/i18n/check-commerce-i18n.mjs), placeholders (per-key registry mirrored in commerce-placeholders.json).
$syntax: ICU MessageFormat: {name} placeholders; plurals as {count, plural, one {...} few {...} other {...}}. Integer plural branches per locale: sk/cs/ro need one+few+other, pl needs one+few+many+other, en/de/hu/it/fr/es need one+other (CLDR; 'many' additionally applies to fractional numbers in sk/cs — a locale MAY define more branches than the EN source, never fewer than its integer set).
$legalNote: Keys flagged legallySensitive carry statutory wording (e.g. the order button 'Objednať s povinnosťou platby' = explicit payment-obligation order per EU consumer law, and the VAT/tax-document lines in e-mails) — translations must preserve the legal meaning for the target market.
